title: Wrong IRA Beneficiary Wipes Out $380K For Your Family
hook: You've been saving for decades to pass wealth to your family — but a single outdated form can legally hand it all to the wrong person and trigger a $380,000 tax catastrophe.
angle: Everyone focuses on building retirement wealth, but almost nobody talks about the administrative mistake that silently destroys it the moment you die — a simple beneficiary designation most people set once and forget forever.
audience: Anyone with a 401k, IRA, or retirement account who has gotten married, divorced, or had children since opening the account
key_numbers: 42% of Americans have outdated or incorrect beneficiaries
$380,000 average loss from probate, taxes, and forced withdrawals
SECURE Act forces heirs to drain inherited accounts in 10 years
37% top tax bracket hit on forced withdrawals
5 minutes to fix it online today
